QiyueAstro Tarot Drawer v1.0.0

- Initial release of the tarot card drawing skill using the QiyueAstro public API.
- Draw single, daily, or multiple cards across 13 spreads—including "one card," "daily card," "three-card," "yes/no," "love," and more.
- Browse the full 78-card Rider-Waite tarot deck and read detailed meanings, keywords, and yes/no verdicts.
- Multilingual support: all content available in English or Chinese.
- No authentication, signup, or API key required.
